title: Development plan version 2
decision: Build in the order M1 to M9 with an estimate of 92 to 138 focused days and no calendar commitment; no pilot stage by founder decision; shops onboarded one at a time for the first two weeks; interviews and a pDaftar test due before M4; legal review before any real customer data or payment
context: Rewritten for PRD version 2 after the change of direction (DEC-012, DEC-013). By founder instruction the agent decided open points without stopping; the founder reviews all six documents at the end.
chosen_option: Nine milestones, single release, validation and legal track in parallel
rationale: Follows the founder decision to build everything before any shop uses it; the agent records that this delays the first real feedback by about five months and that nearly all scope rests on unvalidated assumptions (EVID-034, EVID-019, EVID-020)
